title: Missing Minutes
one_line: A cozy detective puzzle: investigate a blackout, rebuild the true timeline, and accuse the culprit across 3 cases.
how_to_play: Click locations to gather clues, use the up/down arrow buttons to reorder the timeline, then accuse a suspect. Works with mouse or touch.
description: The power went out for a few minutes and something valuable vanished. Missing Minutes is a 3-level detective puzzle: explore each scene, collect witness accounts and hidden evidence, drag the timeline of events back into its true order, weigh the deductions, and name the culprit. Score points for a correct timeline, bonus clues, and a right accusation, unlock the next (harder) case, and chase a personal best rank from Trainee to Master Detective. Built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no libraries, works on desktop and mobile browsers.
